definition: to give someone help with something
description: A young woman in an orange running vest is doubled over at a crowd barrier, sobbing with exhaustion. A man in a blue shirt and cap and another runner in a rainbow tri-suit each take one of her arms, lift her upright and walk her along the road past cheering spectators. The three finish together and end in a tearful hug.
